ability_extra.cpu_fallback_note: cpu_fallback_ops=1/frame is the existing text:color-layout path for static labels; last_cpu_fallback exposes it (no gate-off, not an R1 layout callback)
ability_extra.frame_raster_note: final frame_raster_ms includes the post-run snapshot repaint/readback; fps gates use interval metrics
ability_extra.hitch_note: 2 hitches = the two U21 snapshot readbacks (steady/recover); 2/30s = 4/min; no other hitches
ability_extra.impl_cache: neighbor dense/stripes + top/legend + sibling chip are static and covered by the Golden mask
ability_extra.impl_correctness: real engine relayout boundary (targetFrame) + AbsoluteBox/Align layout; changing target.FixedHeight recomputes marker center from constraints
ability_extra.impl_dirty: four timed target height changes mark only target and its boundary frame; root/body/top/legend/sibling boards stay NeedsLayout=false
ability_extra.impl_edge: final Recover restores base height 120; marker recentered; slot below target shows frame background again; no layout storm
ability_extra.impl_fail: layout delta != height changes, foreign layout dirty, boundary missing, sibling shift, target/marker/slot pixel fail, golden diff != 0 from run 2, fps<55 → exit 1
ability_extra.impl_visible: Spike grows the blue target slab downward and slides the amber marker with it; Recover restores base; neighbor boards and sibling chip never move; HUD shows h/lay/dirty
ability_extra.rss_slope_semantics: 30s correctness window is startup-ramp dominated; leakage verdict belongs to R15 soak
